description: Deployed master dashboard UI. Implemented glassmorphic styling, true black OLED base, and neon status tokens. Integrated useSystemCountdown hook to calculate dynamic real-time remaining duration against the live system clock instead of displaying static absolute end timestamps.
Removed hardcoded '2026-08-03 bypassed' message. The archive index is now fully hydrated and rendering correctly for all dates, including August 3rd.

Resolved Bridge Collapse. Flux corrected a backend write error in aj-pool.ts where parsed items were not correctly saving to time-series JSON archives due to timezone mismatch and fixed inline import errors in routes.ts and aj-pool.ts. DOM removed mock 'Saturday Special' data, implemented strict backend data mapping for the active broadcast, and established a neon red high-contrast fallback state for UI network failures.
status: SUCCESS - Data flowing from RSS to UI

description: Resolved Logic Failure. Flux rewrote the playhead calculation in /api/stream/schedule to enforce strict date matching using the local system clock (America/New_York) rather than raw UTC strings, preventing dropped streams from midnight offsets. Also forced the AJ Pool array to sort descending (newest first) to ensure the fallback safely defaults to the most recent broadcast instead of playing obsolete data from August 3rd.
